claim_one_line: B1692'S BOUND AGAINST THE MEASURED MASSES (P-241; sealed aa36d2667, sha256 ffe0a6e1; PROVED as sealed, both cells hold; the output committed unread at 4eac2b5b1): in the fibre frame with a flat hypercharge line, one covariant Higgs splits the three charged sectors' m2/m3 by at most four (B1692), but at M_Z the leptons' m_mu/m_tau = 0.0589 is 15.98 times the up quarks' m_c/m_t = 0.00368 (3 sigma band 10.37-24.62 with B1637's 10% allowance): one Higgs is EXCLUDED in this frame, so the up quarks need a Higgs of their own; the down-lepton pair (3.14, band 1.91-5.18) is ALLOWED. A structural conclusion, not a number; the outcome was largely known before the seal (B1660's 3.14; main's recall), disclosed. 0 of 19.
